payload.reason: The evidence provides specific performance improvements of the model over state-of-the-art systems, including percentage increases in F1-scores and classification performance across various relations.

claims.text: The model improved the macro-average F1-score by over 7 percent compared to previous state-of-the-art systems.
The model achieved F1-score improvements of 6 points on Comparison and 7 points on Temporal relations compared to the best previous systems.
The model improved implicit relation classification performance by around 2 to 8 percent on specific relations compared to the baseline Bi-LSTM model.
The full model achieved a performance boost of 3.02 in macro F1-score for implicit discourse relations compared to previous models.
